executive_summary: The most urgent risk is a customer database holding 1,284,000 records that is open to the internet, where a single session from Brazil read 48,500 records on 4 November. A storage bucket with customer data and a server with remote desktop open are also reachable from the internet.
key_messages: Remove internet access to the customer database and review the Brazil session
Block public read access on the S3 bucket holding customer data
Close remote desktop to the internet and enforce MFA for administrators
correlated_story: Each signal alone could look routine. Together they show a regulated customer database open to the internet, the user's first sign-in from Brazil in 90 days, and one session reading far more records than normal. That combination is why this risk ranks first.
